name: external_actrainer_patch_tick_ac
description: Managed C# trainer holding health through repeated WriteProcessMemory calls. Tests whether patch signals transfer from native code to .NET/PInvoke. Operator-driven capture; no manipulation section.

extra.provenance: docs/external-cheats/README.md; fill actual tool/game hashes and runtime version before collection.
extra.operator_commands: Enable only option 1 (God Mode); keep ESP, armor, ammo and grenades OFF. Observe health=1000 for 30 seconds while taking bot damage. Toggle option 1 OFF, choose 0 to quit, then press Enter in the capture shell. Source loop requests a write every 100 ms; measure actual cadence.
extra.success_criterion: Verify intended effect using game state, tool log, or payload marker independently of detector output. Record failed pilots separately.
extra.notes: Fresh AC and the same local bot match per replicate. See docs/external-cheats/evaluation-plan.md. Keep AC alive through cooldown; runner performs final cleanup.
